positions.name: ActionEnrollsActorInRole
positions.frame: how does a system action automatically enroll its performer in a role?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around the automatic allocation of reviewer status to a memory's creator by virtue of saving it. src-1 states the rule the e2e suite enforces — saving enrolls the creator as reviewer — while src-2 subordinates the probe memory's entire existence to carrying that assertion. The set holds the rule and its instrumental servant together: one performs the authority-ranking allocation, the other exists solely to validate it.
